newsitem.title: USA: San Diego house burns in police shootout.
newsitem.headline: San Diego house burns in police shootout.

text.p: A police SWAT team looking for suspected jewel robbers exchanged gunfire with the alleged bandits Friday then lobbed teargas cannisters into the house, setting it on fire.
Police later found two bodies in the burned rubble.
San Diego police spokesman Dave Cohen said SWAT team officers armed with a search warrant had forced open the door of a house where some suspects were believed to be living.
He said officers were fired upon and returned fire. They then threw teargas canisters into the house and the building erupted in flames.
Cohen said two people, possibly the parents of one of the suspects, had run out of the house before the fire erupted. Later, police heard a single gunshot inside, he said.
No police were injured in the incident.
At the same time, at least eight other suspects in last week's armed robbery at a jewelry store were arrested in separate raids by police in the San Diego area, police said.
